description:
Let us introduce ourselves individually.

Ada - She is interested in art, language, reading, writing, science, designing, graphic design. She is strategic, pretty good at leading a team.

Artemis - She is interested in art, animation, writing, reading. She is really creative, unique. 

Mihriban - She is interested in music (specifically violin), reading, biology. She gives great ideas, great opinions that helps the team.

Our team is searching for someone who is interested in these subjects etc.
summary: Basically, we managed to make a mini-zine about some of the equipment that NASA invented to explore / go to the Moon and the Mars. Although, we had a really short time to do it... We drew each invention by hand and wrote the descriptions nicely. The team members Ada and Artemis was in charge of drawing. Mihriban was in charge of writing the descriptions. We managed to make this zine in such short time. But we hope that you like it. And lastly, thank you for your attention to our team ShootForTheStars and our zine / project.
details: It gives information about the inventions that NASA made to explore the Moon and the Mars. We drew the inventions by hand and let the other member write the descriptions about the invention. We used Wikipedia, NASA's official site, Procreate and Clip Studio Paint. We intend to inform people about the inventions.
